title: HELLO, VIHAR.
subtitle: A space to play.
caption: Welcome to Vihar. A space for original browser games, familiar little details, and a little escape. Our first stop: Bap Ka Rasta. Follow along, and find your kind of play at vihar.online.
alt: Vihar welcome poster with its original emblem and a playful illustrated courtyard.

title:
PLAY, JUST
BECAUSE.
subtitle: No grand plan required.
caption: Remember playing just for the joy of it? One more turn. One more detour. That is the feeling behind Vihar. What game made you forget the time?
alt: Vihar poster featuring playful courtyard objects, a kite and game pieces.

title:
YOUR CITY.
YOUR OWN WAY.
subtitle: Bap Ka Rasta · Free-roaming driving
note: Promotional concept art · More cities and player rides coming soon.
caption: Meet Bap Ka Rasta: free-roaming driving through familiar Indian streets. Apna sheher. Apni sawaari. Apna rasta. Explore the game and its growing world at vihar.online.
alt: Bap Ka Rasta promotional city scene with the updated vehicle line-up and blocky game characters.

title:
TAKE THE
LONG WAY.
subtitle: Mumbai · A familiar kind of escape
note: Promotional concept art · Fictional Mumbai-inspired city.
caption: A sea breeze, a side street, a chai stop. Sometimes the best route is the one you did not plan. Explore Bap Ka Rasta’s Mumbai-inspired world through Vihar. Where would you turn first?
alt: Golden Mumbai-inspired promotional artwork with a waterfront, roundabout and lively city traffic.

title:

note: City concept artwork · Coming soon; release date unannounced.

title:
BIG WHEELS.
BIGGER DETOURS.

caption: From the Thar to the Fortuner, Creta-style SUV and Innova-style MPV, the Bap Ka Rasta world has room for different rides. Which one matches your mood? Explore the full vehicle line-up on Vihar.
alt: Creative garage artwork showing the updated SUV and vehicle models with the game’s mechanic.

title:
CHAI PE
MILTE HAIN.

note: Promotional illustration based on the original character cast.
caption: Every street has its people. Meet Sachin, Raju Kaka, Meera Tai and Sameer—familiar faces in the world of Bap Ka Rasta. A little chai. A lot of stories. Meet the cast at vihar.online.
alt: Sachin, Raju Kaka, Meera Tai and Sameer sharing chai in a generated game-style illustration.

title:

KEEP WANDERING.

note: City concept artwork · Coming soon; release date unannounced.
caption: A bridge on the horizon, riverside roads and a city full of stories. Our Kolkata concept brings another familiar world into Bap Ka Rasta’s future. What would be your first stop?
alt: Kolkata city concept with Howrah Bridge, a taxi and a blue electric rickshaw.

title:

ESCAPE.
subtitle: Open a browser. Find your kind of play.
caption: A little break can go a long way. Vihar brings original games to your browser, with worlds worth wandering through. Start with Bap Ka Rasta at vihar.online.
alt: Vihar brand poster inviting players to take a small break, with its illustrated courtyard.

title:
TWO WHEELS.
FULL AZAADI.

note: Promotional vehicle artwork · Player selection coming later.
caption: The angular Dio-style scooter or the orange-frame Duke-style KTM? The updated models are part of Bap Ka Rasta’s living streets. Tell us your pick while more player rides take shape.
alt: Creative vehicle artwork featuring a turquoise scooter and white-orange KTM-style motorcycle.

title:

caption: Palm-lined roads, warm light and the Marina breeze. Here is a look at the Chennai direction for Bap Ka Rasta. More cities, more ways to find your own route.
alt: Chennai promotional city concept showing a coastal road, palms, scooter and SUV.

title:

caption: Tiffin carriers, fruit sellers, students, neighbours and familiar faces. Bap Ka Rasta has 20 original character designs bringing its streets to life. Meet Nilesh, Farah, Suresh, Shanta Aaji and the rest of the cast on Vihar.
alt: Generated market scene featuring the game’s original dabbawala, fruit seller, elder and other street characters.

title:
MORE ROADS.
MORE POSSIBILITIES.

note: Promotional artwork · View the actual updated map on Vihar.
caption: The Bap Ka Rasta map has grown: connected avenues, smaller lanes, four roundabouts and 29 destinations. Explore the updated map and world renders on Vihar, then find your own way through the game.

title:
